summary: The verifier compares every README key for every line (with exact type), line order and total against sealed statements. The sealed values match my own trace of tariff MD-2 plus the instruction's 'today's step stands' rule for FLEX allowance and not-over lines. Isolating fixtures reject each plausible wrong implementation I traced: floor of summed KB, ceil of summed KB, per-session floor, a single shared allowance, a flat rate, an off-by-one at the 1024 MB tier boundary, account-level tiering, clamping negative overage or charge, and a changed FLEX allowance. Exact types, permitted extra keys and relabelled or shuffled files do not cause false rejections.

checks_performed: Derived expected semantics from tariff MD-2 and instruction.md: per-session ceil to MB; BASIC 2048 and PLUS 10240; FLEX allowance stays at today's 5120 (tariff silent); over = used - allowance, left unclamped for not-over lines; over lines charged rate*min(over,1024) + 1*max(over-1024,0); not-over lines keep today's charge, over*rate, which can be negative; total = sum of charges

Recomputed by hand: S1, S2, S3, S4 and S5 (01), all five lines of 02, R1 to R6 (03), ZZZZZZZZZZ, 0 and ONLY (04), F1 to F6 (05), N1 to N7 and the negative total (06), X1 to X5 (07), WF5UR40 and 7F6H1 (08), and ABCDEFGHIJ and L2 (09). All matched the sealed statements

Traced wrong implementations against the fixtures: the original floor of summed KB fails S1; ceil of summed KB fails S2 and S3; per-session floor fails S1; +1 per session fails S1 (whole-MB sessions); a single shared allowance or swapped plans fail P1 and P2; a flat rate fails R3 and others; tier off-by-one fails R2 (40960 vs 40921); account-level tiering fails any multi-line over file; clamping over or charge to 0 fails N1, N2, N5, N6, X1 and X4; a changed FLEX allowance fails F1 to F4

Checked that alternative correct formulas for the tier charge (min/max form, or a conditional on over <= 1024) all give the same results for negative, zero and positive overage, so the not_over expectations do not require one Oracle-specific form
Checked comparator: parsed JSON; exact type and value for account, total and each LINE_KEYS field; line count and order; extra keys ignored (tests/test_outputs.py:197-211)

Checked relabel pass: id/line/session shuffles and account-name changes are applied consistently to input and expectation; per-session rounding is order-independent, so a correct implementation cannot be falsely rejected
Checked load(): roster SHA-256 and row counts, rule 1.2 limits enforced on every graded file, and silent-figure lines confined to families that grade them (tests/test_outputs.py:159-194)
Checked driver byte-equality test against instruction.md:1 requirement and test.sh reward gating

Checked execution path: python3 -I -S as uid 65534 on /app after chmod a+rX and the write seal; no third-party imports are needed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE is set; stale sourceless pyc in __pycache__ is never imported
